title: fix(plugin-grid): "Match on" offers only fields the server takes as a match key (#27567)

Fixes #27567

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：导入向导「Match on」只列出服务端接受的匹配字段：多值查找、多选、标签、复选组、JSON/地址等结构化字段不再出现；向导字段形状新增可选 `multiple`，由控制台的两处字段构建（列表导入、AI Excel 导入）从对象定义带过来。
- 为什么改：服务端已拒绝把这类字段当匹配键（#27465 / PR #27562，`400 INVALID_REQUEST`），但向导照样让用户勾选，要到「Validate」才被整单拒绝。
- 风险与回滚：只动前端：一个过滤条件、一个可选 prop 键、两处字段构建各一行；不改 spec、不改服务端、不加元数据键。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.tsx`（`isMatchKeyField` 与 `matchable` 过滤）→ `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/importTargetFields.ts`（带 `multiple`）→ 新测试 `ImportWizard.matchKeyFields-27567.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.matchKeyFields-27567.test.tsx`，预期 1/1 通过（只剩 code、email、owner、stage 四个可选）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

In "Update existing" and "Update if matched, else create", the import wizard's "Match on" listed every mapped field. Since #27465 the server refuses a match key whose value is a list or a structured payload, so ticking such a field got the whole import refused at Validate. "Match on" now offers only the mapped fields the server takes as a key.

- **One rule, read from the spec.** `isMatchKeyField` in `ImportWizard.tsx` is `!STRUCTURED_JSON_TYPES.has(type) && !isMultiValueField({ type, multiple })`, the same two `@objectstack/spec/data` definitions the server's `multiValueMatchKeyRefusal` (`@objectstack/core`) composes. `plugin-grid` already imported from `@objectstack/spec/data`, so no dependency edge and no `package.json` change. `matchable` is the existing list with that filter added: no new widget, dialog or hook.
- **`multiple` on the field shape.** `ImportWizardProps['fields'][number]` takes an optional `multiple?: boolean` (the declared widening: `ImportWizardProps` is re-exported by name from the package entry). The wizard does not build its field shape; its hosts do, so the flag is carried at both:
  - `importTargetFields` (`app-shell/src/views/importTargetFields.ts`, the console list's Import), only when the schema says `multiple: true`;
  - `normalizeFields` in `ExcelImportBar.tsx` (the AI build panel's spreadsheet import, which offers all three write modes), the same way. Cleared for this PR by the seat that holds that path.
  `identityImportFields` (text/email only) is unchanged.
- **Fields left out.** A `multiple: true` `lookup`, `user`, `select`, `radio`, `file` or `image`; any `multiselect`, `checkboxes` or `tags`; any `json`, `composite`, `repeater`, `record`, `location`, `address` or `vector`. A single-value lookup or select and every scalar field stay offered. A host that leaves `multiple` out still has the inherently multi and structured types filtered by type alone.
- **Docblock.** `refusedOptionValue`'s note said the field shape does not carry `multiple`; it now says the cell check does not read it (a host may leave it out), so its behaviour is unchanged.

## Tests

- New `ui/packages/plugin-grid/src/ImportWizard.matchKeyFields-27567.test.tsx`: on an upsert import with ten mapped fields, "Match on" lists exactly `code` (text), `email`, `owner` (single lookup), `stage` (single select); `owners` (lookup, `multiple: true`), `stages` (select, `multiple: true`), `labels` (tags), `regions` (multiselect), `meta` (json), `site` (address) are absent.
- `importTargetFields.test.ts`: a new case pins that `multiple: true` is carried and `multiple: false` / absent is not.

## Acceptance notes

- The card's three acceptance lines: the field shape carries `multiple` from the object schema (both hosts that build it); "Match on" lists only mapped fields the rule admits; the change is a filter on `matchable`.
- `ExcelImportBar`'s one carried line has no pin of its own: its existing tests (`ExcelImportBar.sharedSelect-11865`) compare the wizard's fields as JSON text, and they stay byte-identical because the key is written only when true.
- A saved server mapping's `upsertKey` that names such a field is applied as the mapping says (`setMatchFields(m.upsertKey…)`), and the server's refusal names the mapping; the wizard does not edit an authored mapping. Not changed here.
- `importTargetFields.test.ts` is outside both of `app-shell`'s tsc programs (`tsc --noEmit` and `tsconfig.test.json` list neither it nor the other `views/*.test.ts` beside it, measured with `--listFiles`); vitest runs it. Pre-existing, not widened by this PR.
